seo.title: How Client-Controlled Food Log Sharing Works | Caltrac AI
seo.description: Apply, get your linking code, and review meals your clients choose to share. Clients control access and can stop sharing at any time.
seo.h1: How Caltrac AI for Professionals works

intro: Joining takes four steps. You apply, a person at Caltrac AI reviews your application, we set up your account and give you a linking code, and your clients enter that code in Caltrac Connect and send a request; access starts when you accept it. Clients can stop sharing at any time.

steps.heading: Step 1. Apply
steps.text: Fill in the application form. Only your name and email are required. The other details just give the review more to go on.

steps.heading: Step 2. We review
steps.text: A person at Caltrac AI reads every application. The review is manual, and you get the outcome by email within 24–48 hours.

steps.heading: Step 3. We set up your account
steps.text: If you are approved, we create your account, email you the details and give you your linking code. Nothing is created before approval.

steps.heading: Step 4. Your clients connect with your code
steps.text: Each client enters your code in Caltrac Connect and sends you a request. Access starts when you accept it. From then on you can review the meals they share and comment on them.
See what linked clients share: their meals (photo, food, estimated calories and macros), their nutrition goals and how their net calories compare with those goals.
Comment on a specific meal. The client reads it in the app, next to the food.
Accept or decline a client's request.
Search for, invite or add a client.
See a client's meals before the client grants access.
Keep access after a client stops sharing.
Install Caltrac AI on iPhone or Android.
Tap Caltrac Connect in the app's top bar, choose Connect a professional, and enter your professional's linking code.
Access starts when your professional accepts. Log meals as usual; their comments appear next to the meals.
